verdict.rationale: Belvo is an API platform, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question. The evidence only says users get set up with API keys and that Belvo offers MCP servers. Nothing documents issuing credentials with restricted scopes, permissions or least-privilege limits for an agent; the IP- and mTLS-based options concern rate-limit bypass, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
